Leidos Holdings (LDOS) Stock Price Declined While Alpine Woods Capital Investors Has Boosted Its Position; Apple (AAPL) Holder United Capital Financial Advisers Has Decreased Position as Shares Declined
May 15, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Alpine Woods Capital Investors Llc increased its stake in Leidos Holdings Inc. (LDOS) by 28.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alpine Woods Capital Investors Llc bought 64,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 290,825 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.78M, up from 226,025 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alpine Woods Capital Investors Llc who had been investing in Leidos Holdings Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.35B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.15% or $0.7179 during the last trading session, reaching $61.5821. About 252,942 shares traded. Leidos Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:LDOS) has risen 24.71% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.16% the S&P500.
